description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the current instance **ID** on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.  

><notice>  
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID; otherwise, the invocation will fail.  
- If there is no <props="intl"><ph>**Instance Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value, you do not need to specify it.  

></notice>  

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API is 5 for each Alibaba Cloud account.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-device-tunnel --tunnel-id d4098041-a560-000 --iot-instance-id iot-000-v6000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
